inv.desc_en:
Part of our office is shared as a co-working space, both with entrepreneurs, small work teams or freelancers. Spacious and bright loft. Kitchen with microwave, coffee maker and fridge. Closed meeting room. 600MB fiber optics and cleaning lady. The free space is for 4 people for €560+VAT (includes water, gas, electricity, cleaning expenses). Cold - hot air conditioning. Gas radiator heating. For 2 people €300 + VAT, for 3 people €420 + VAT, for 5 people €650 + VAT, for 6 people €780 + VAT

FULL PLAN:
- Fixed workstations for exclusive use.
- Meeting room at no additional cost.
- Common rest and meeting areas: bar-office, terrace-garden.
- Water.
